full_prompt_en: A square image of an aged Chinese-style hanging-scroll painting shows a single adult man standing full length at the center of a warm brown silk ground. He faces forward in a formal, contained pose. A flat black brimmed hat rests above a pale face with narrow eyes, a short mustache, and a long dark beard tapering toward the chest. He wears a broad pale tan robe whose very wide sleeves meet over the hands at the abdomen. The robe falls straight to the ankles, with delicate dark lines tracing folds and a narrow hanging tassel or accessory at his right side. A dark hem and black shoes anchor the figure near the bottom. The man occupies only a modest portion of the field, leaving substantial unpainted brown space around his silhouette. Vertical columns of black Chinese calligraphy run down the far left and right edges, with a few small red square seals toward the lower right. The calligraphy is visibly present as historic inscription, but the small characters are not transcribed here. The silk or paper surface is mottled with age: uneven tan, ochre, and umber stains, worn spots, and fine weave texture. The face and hands are carefully drawn but softly colored. The garment has restrained volume, with thin shaded creases rather than dramatic light and shadow. The framing is frontal and symmetrical, giving the figure a quiet ceremonial gravity. No room, landscape, or cast shadow is depicted. The image combines figure painting, generous empty ground, inscription, and material age into a formal document-like composition. Its slow visual rhythm comes from the wide still robe, slim vertical texts, and muted warm field.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形旧中国式挂轴图像在暖褐绢底中央描绘一名全身站立的成年男子。他正面朝向，姿势正式而收敛。平沿黑帽压在浅色面孔上方，脸有细眼、短髭和垂至胸前的长黑须。他穿宽大的浅褐袍，极宽袖口在腹前合住双手。袍身笔直垂到脚踝，细深线勾出褶皱，右侧挂有窄穗或饰件。深色袍摆与黑鞋把人物固定在下方。人物仅占画幅有限部分，四周留有大量未画的褐色空间。左右远侧竖排黑色汉字题跋，右下有数枚小红方印。书法作为历史性文字清楚存在，但这里不转录细小字句。绢或纸表面因年代而斑驳：不均匀棕、赭、深褐污迹、磨损点和细织纹。脸和手画得谨慎，着色却柔和。衣服体积克制，靠细阴影褶线而非剧烈光影呈现。正面且对称的安排给人物安静的仪式重量。没有房间、风景或投影。图像把人物画、宽敞空地、题跋和材质年代感合成正式文献般构图。宽阔静止的袍、细竖文字与低饱和暖色域形成缓慢视觉节奏。
style_prompt_en: The historical silk-painting treatment uses a broad aged tan field, restrained figure color, spare fine contour lines, and vertical calligraphic columns. A small centered full form stands within ample negative space, making stillness and proportion more important than dramatic lighting. Pale ochre and brown washes describe large clothlike areas; narrow dark strokes pick out folds, features, and small accessories. Black brush lettering at the margins and a few cinnabar seals balance the central image as graphic elements. Mottled stains, slight abrasion, and visible woven grain communicate the old material surface. Shadows remain quiet and shallow, with no strongly defined setting. The overall effect is ceremonial, measured, and documentary, with elegant spacing and timeworn texture carrying the visual character.
style_prompt_zh: 历史绢本绘画处理使用宽阔旧黄褐底、克制人物色彩、稀疏细轮廓和竖向书法列。较小居中全形位于大片留白内，让静止和比例比戏剧照明重要。浅赭与褐色色洗表现宽大布面，窄深笔触挑出褶、五官和小配件。边缘黑色笔墨字与少数朱印作为图形元素平衡中央。斑驳污迹、轻微磨损和可见织纹传达老旧材质。阴影安静而浅，没有强界定场所。整体仪式性、有尺度而带文献感，优雅间距与经年肌理承担视觉性格。
theme_en: A standing scholar in a pale robe and black hat on aged silk with calligraphy columns
theme_zh: 浅袍黑帽文人立于旧绢本上，两侧排列书法题跋
name: Emperor Huizong of Song
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
